photo.caption: Junk food and its advertising are commercial determinants of health.
photo.description: An ad featuring women drinking Coke in-between shopping. Headline: “The good old pause that refreshes” This famous Coca-Cola slogan emphasizes the product’s value as a comforting, timeless break. Supporting Tagline: “Shopping won’t tire you out if you take time to pause and refresh” It aligns Coca-Cola with self-care and maintaining stamina during daily activities like shopping.
